title: Delete the factory and its embedded payload
description:
Delete the factory. ticfac's Phase 2 moved it in three parts (ticks ek7, b3a,
0e1) and it works there: `ticfac factory deploy|setup|status|dashboard` and
`ticfac cloud run|stop|status|logs|trace|supervisor`.

GOES:
  - `internal/factory/**` — the root package, dashboard, credentials, and the
    jobprotocol/lifecycle/runstate contract-parity homes.
  - `internal/gatewaytrace` — production code in the factory dashboard imports
    it, and it depends only on factory/credentials. It moves out with them.
  - `cloud/factory` and `cloud/sandbox` — the embedded payload. //go:embed
    cannot reach across modules, which is why it had to travel with the code;
    cloud/sandbox alone is 236K of build context.
  - `cmd/tk/cmd/factory.go`, `factory_dashboard.go`, and the
    run|stop|status|logs|trace|supervisor subcommands from `cloud.go`,
    `cloud_logs.go`, `cloud_trace.go`, `cloud_supervisor.go`.
  - The module-root embeds those leave unused (`embedded.go`: FactoryFS,
    SandboxFS).

DO NOT TOUCH: `internal/tkcontract`. The factory's contract tests imported it,
which is why ticfac reimplemented those tests against its own `internal/schema`
rather than copying it — cmd/tk's version and root contract gate still need it
here.

Check before deleting: `internal/sandbox` and `internal/gatewaytrace` were both
found reaching into factory. azq should have settled sandbox; confirm rather
than assume.

Independent of nkf — different trees — so it can run in the same wave, but only
if nothing in it touches a file nkf touches. Check that at dispatch (the wave
composition rule), not after.
acceptance_criteria: internal/factory, internal/gatewaytrace, cloud/factory and cloud/sandbox are gone, along with the factory and cloud commands and the module-root embeds they leave unused; internal/tkcontract is untouched and cmd/tk's version and contract gate still work; the same commands work from the ticfac CLI; go build ./... passes after every commit; go test -short -count=1 ./... green.
